description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the Favorites module in SuiteCRM, testing various behaviors such as object instantiation, deletion, and retrieval of favorites and related IDs.

classes.name: FavoritesTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the Favorites module in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: testFavorites
methods.description: Tests the creation of a Favorites bean and verifies its type and attributes.

methods.name: testdeleteFavorite
methods.description: Tests the deleteFavorite method with an empty ID to verify it returns false.

methods.name: testgetFavoriteID
methods.description: Tests the getFavoriteID method with blank and specific string parameters, expecting false results.

methods.name: testgetCurrentUserSidebarFavorites
methods.description: Tests retrieving current user sidebar favorites with and without parameters, expecting an array.
